title: Decide ICS handling; bounded ICS parser with sanitization
description: Decision plus parser crate with size, recursion and recurrence limits and sanitization (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-calendars-00 L210-228, L292-296). Default to needs-action; never auto-RSVP.
acceptance_criteria: Tests use an independent oracle: each assertion cites and quotes the governing draft sentence (file + line) or uses RFC/draft-published vectors; the code under test is never its own oracle. Decision recorded; parser tests use RFC 5545 examples and oversized/deeply nested fixtures.
notes: DECIDED by Mark 2026-10-20: not supported for now. The chat-calendars capability advertises supportsIcsParsing: false; no iCalendar parser dependency; .ics attachments stay plain files and clients may parse client-side (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-calendars-00 L218, L230). Document the constraint in the chat-calendars crate docs. Revisit if a consumer needs server-side parsing (then evaluate wrapping a maintained crate such as calcard with the L290-296 limits).
close_reason: Decided by Mark 2026-10-20; decision recorded in notes
